description: Extreme close-up of a woman squinting through a gold eye loupe at a minute brass cog held in a pair of tweezers right in front of her eye. She sits back at a workbench covered with tweezers, tins and springs, in a shop whose walls are hung with wall clocks, and holds the loupe up to her eye. Next she points a fine tool into the open case of a mantel clock, its brass wheels visible behind the glass. Then a tall grandfather clock with brass weights and a swinging pendulum fills the frame, and finally she stands with her arms out under the enormous brass gears of a tower clock.
